انحنين (form VII)
# اِنْحَنَيْنَ (inḥanayna) /in.ħa.naj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā)
# اِنْحَنِينَ (inḥanīna) /in.ħa.niː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā)
